graphite_query: MATCH (c:CallSiteNode) WHERE c.callee_class = 'com.google.common.base.Preconditions' AND c.callee_name = 'checkNotNull' RETURN count(DISTINCT c.caller_signature) AS callers
codegraph_sql: select count(distinct e.source) from edges e join nodes n on n.id=e.target where n.name='checkNotNull' and n.file_path='com/google/common/base/Preconditions.java' and e.kind='calls'
